items.label: Current office
items.text: California Attorney General (34th) since April 23, 2021. (sources: California Department of Justice https://oag.ca.gov/about [search summary, primary])

items.label: Offices held
items.text: Member, Alameda City Council, December 2010–November 2012 (vice mayor from December 21, 2010); Member, California State Assembly (District 18), 2012–2021; California Attorney General, 2021–present. (sources: Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rob_Bonta [search summary, secondary]; Ballotpedia https://ballotpedia.org/Rob_Bonta [search summary, secondary]; Rob Bonta campaign https://robbonta.com/about/ [search summary, primary])

items.label: Earlier career
items.text: Deputy City Attorney, City and County of San Francisco, before his Assembly service. (sources: California Department of Justice https://oag.ca.gov/about [search summary, primary])

items.label: Education
items.text: B.A. in history, Yale University (1993); J.D., Yale Law School (1998). The official bio names both institutions; the years come from Vote Smart. (sources: California Department of Justice https://oag.ca.gov/about [search summary, primary]; Vote Smart https://justfacts.votesmart.org/candidate/biography/129483/ [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Offices held
items.text: Huntington Beach City Attorney (elected), first elected 2014 and re-elected twice, serving until 2025; Deputy Assistant Attorney General, Civil Rights Division, U.S. Department of Justice, appointed in 2025 and left later that year. (sources: San Joaquin Valley Sun https://sjvsun.com/news/politics/former-huntington-beach-city-attorney-michael-gates-launches-ag-campaign/ [search summary, secondary]; PublicCEO https://www.publicceo.com/2025/02/huntington-beach-city-attorney-to-join-the-department-of-justice/ [search summary, secondary]; LAist https://laist.com/news/politics/huntington-beachs-michael-gates-quits-justice-department [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Career
items.text: Worked in software development before law school; partner at a law firm before 2014. After leaving the Department of Justice he was reported to have rejoined the Huntington Beach City Attorney's office as chief assistant city attorney. (sources: Chapman University Fowler School of Law https://blogs.chapman.edu/law/?p=11936 [search summary, secondary]; LAist https://laist.com/news/politics/huntington-beachs-michael-gates-quits-justice-department [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Education
items.text: Undergraduate degree, Pepperdine University; J.D., Chapman University Dale E. Fowler School of Law (class of 2008). (sources: Chapman University Fowler School of Law https://blogs.chapman.edu/law/?p=11936 [search summary, secondary]; Chapman University Fowler School of Law https://blogs.chapman.edu/law/?p=8706 [search summary, secondary])
